User.title: User
User.description: A user of the trading platform.

uid.description: The unique identifier for the user.

displayName.description: The display name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

balance.description: The current cash balance of the user.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user was created.

PortfolioItem.title: Portfolio Item
PortfolioItem.description: A single asset held in a user's portfolio.

uid.description: The unique identifier for the user who owns this asset.

symbol.description: The ticker symbol of the asset.

averagePrice.description: The average purchase price of the asset.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the portfolio item was last updated.

Trade.title: Trade
Trade.description: A record of a buy or sell transaction.

uid.description: The unique identifier for the user who made the trade.

symbol.description: The ticker symbol of the asset traded.

price.description: The price per unit at the time of the trade.

timestamp.description: The timestamp when the trade occurred.

Alert.title: Alert
Alert.description: A user-defined price alert for a stock.

uid.description: The unique identifier for the user who created the alert.

symbol.description: The ticker symbol of the asset.

threshold.description: The price threshold to trigger the alert.

direction.description: Trigger when price goes above or below threshold.

status.description: The current status of the alert.

PaymentMethod.title: PaymentMethod
PaymentMethod.description: A payment method available for deposits.

name.description: Name of the payment method (e.g., M-Pesa, Card).

details.description: Instructions or details (e.g., phone number for M-Pesa).

isActive.description: Whether the payment method is currently active.

createdAt.description: When the payment method was added.
